questions.q: What does <!DOCTYPE HTML> tell the browser?
questions.qAf: Wat sê <!DOCTYPE HTML> vir die blaaier?
options: To show the page title in the tab
optionsAf: Om die bladsytitel in die oortjie te wys
questions.explain: <!DOCTYPE HTML> is the first line of the page. It tells the browser to use the HTML 5 standard.
questions.explainAf: <!DOCTYPE HTML> is die eerste reël van die bladsy. Dit sê vir die blaaier om die HTML 5-standaard te gebruik.

questions.q: Which code makes a link that opens in a new tab?
questions.qAf: Watter kode maak 'n skakel wat in 'n nuwe oortjie oopmaak?
questions.explain: A link is an <a> tag: href is the web address and target="_blank" opens it in a new tab.
questions.explainAf: 'n Skakel is 'n <a>-etiket: href is die webadres en target="_blank" maak dit in 'n nuwe oortjie oop.

questions.q: Where is internal CSS placed?
questions.qAf: Waar word interne CSS geplaas?
options: In a style attribute inside a tag
questions.explain: Internal CSS sits in a <style> block in the <head> and applies to one page only. A style attribute is inline CSS, and a separate .css file is external CSS.
questions.explainAf: Interne CSS sit in 'n <style>-blok in die <head> en geld net vir een bladsy. 'n style-attribuut is inlyn-CSS, en 'n aparte .css-lêer is eksterne CSS.

questions.q: Which colour is rgb(255, 0, 0)?
questions.qAf: Watter kleur is rgb(255, 0, 0)?
questions.explain: rgb(R, G, B) gives each colour a value from 0 to 255. Full red with no green and no blue is red, the same as #FF0000.
questions.explainAf: rgb(R, G, B) gee elke kleur 'n waarde van 0 tot 255. Volle rooi met geen groen en geen blou nie is rooi, dieselfde as #FF0000.

questions.q: In Excel, what does the colon (:) in E3:E11 mean?
questions.qAf: Wat beteken die dubbelpunt (:) in E3:E11 in Excel?
questions.explain: A range is a group of cells. The colon means “through to”, so E3:E11 is cell E3 through to cell E11.
questions.explainAf: 'n Selreeks is 'n groep selle. Die dubbelpunt beteken “tot en met”, dus is E3:E11 sel E3 tot en met sel E11.

questions.q: Which chart is best for showing trends over time?
questions.qAf: Watter grafiek is die beste om neigings oor tyd te wys?
questions.explain: A line chart shows trends over time. A pie (or donut) shows parts of a whole, and a bar or column chart compares categories.
questions.explainAf: 'n Lyngrafiek wys neigings oor tyd. 'n Sirkel- (of donut-)grafiek wys dele van 'n geheel, en 'n staaf- of kolomgrafiek vergelyk kategorieë.

questions.q: Which formula gives the smallest value in the range C2 to C31?
questions.qAf: Watter formule gee die kleinste waarde in die reeks C2 tot C31?
questions.explain: =MIN(C2:C31) uses the whole range. =MIN(C2,C31) only compares the two cells C2 and C31.
questions.explainAf: =MIN(C2:C31) gebruik die hele reeks. =MIN(C2,C31) vergelyk net die twee selle C2 en C31.

questions.q: Which Java data type stores only true or false?
questions.qAf: Watter Java-datatipe stoor net true of false?
questions.explain: A boolean stores only true or false, e.g. boolean loggedIn = true;. int stores whole numbers, double decimals and String text.
questions.explainAf: 'n boolean stoor net true of false, bv. boolean loggedIn = true;. int stoor heelgetalle, double desimale getalle en String teks.

questions.q: A Linear Pattern has 5 occurrences. How many holes does the part have in total?
questions.qAf: 'n Linear Pattern het 5 occurrences. Hoeveel gate het die onderdeel altesaam?
questions.explain: Occurrences is the total number of copies, including the original seed feature. So 5 occurrences means 5 holes.
questions.explainAf: Occurrences is die totale getal kopieë, insluitend die oorspronklike saadkenmerk (seed). Dus beteken 5 occurrences 5 gate.

questions.q: Which Arduino Uno memory stores the variables while the program runs?
questions.qAf: Watter geheue van die Arduino Uno stoor die veranderlikes terwyl die program loop?
questions.explain: SRAM (2 KB) is volatile: it holds variables while the program runs. Flash memory (32 KB) is non-volatile and stores the program itself.
questions.explainAf: SRAM (2 KB) is vlugtig: dit hou veranderlikes terwyl die program loop. Flitsgeheue (32 KB) is nie-vlugtig en stoor die program self.

sections.title: True or false
sections.intro: Decide whether each statement is true or false.
sections.introAf: Besluit of elke stelling waar of onwaar is.

questions.q: A class selector in CSS starts with a hashtag (#).
questions.qAf: 'n Klasselektor in CSS begin met 'n hutsmerk (#).
questions.explain: A class starts with a full stop, e.g. .red-text. An ID starts with a hashtag, e.g. #H4-green.
questions.explainAf: 'n Klas begin met 'n punt, bv. .red-text. 'n ID begin met 'n hutsmerk, bv. #H4-green.

questions.q: Double-clicking the Fill Handle fills the data to the left.
questions.qAf: As jy op die vulhandvatsel dubbelklik, word die data na links gevul.
questions.explain: Double-clicking only fills downward, to the end of the adjacent data. Dragging works up, down, left or right.
questions.explainAf: Dubbelklik vul net afwaarts, tot aan die einde van die aangrensende data. Sleep werk op, af, links of regs.

questions.q: Abstraction means focusing on the important information and filtering out unnecessary detail.
questions.qAf: Abstraksie beteken om op die belangrike inligting te fokus en onnodige besonderhede uit te filter.
questions.explain: That is abstraction, e.g. a map that shows only roads and landmarks, not every blade of grass.
questions.explainAf: Dit is abstraksie, bv. 'n kaart wat net paaie en landmerke wys, nie elke grashalm nie.

questions.q: In Java, the class name must match the file name exactly.
questions.qAf: In Java moet die klasnaam presies ooreenstem met die lêernaam.
questions.explain: public class HelloWorld must be saved as HelloWorld.java.
questions.explainAf: public class HelloWorld moet as HelloWorld.java gestoor word.

questions.q: A fully constrained FreeCAD sketch turns orange.
questions.qAf: 'n FreeCAD-skets wat volledig beperk is, word oranje.
questions.explain: A fully constrained sketch (zero DOF) turns green. Orange means overconstrained: too many constraints, which cause conflicts.
questions.explainAf: 'n Volledig beperkte skets (nul DOF) word groen. Oranje beteken oorbeperk: te veel beperkings, wat konflikte veroorsaak.

questions.q: For variable motor speed, the enable pin must go to an Arduino pin marked with a tilde (~).
questions.qAf: Vir veranderlike motorspoed moet die enable-pen aan 'n Arduino-pen met 'n tilde (~) gekoppel word.
questions.explain: Only the ~ pins (~3, ~5, ~6, ~9, ~10, ~11) can produce the PWM timing signal for speed control.
questions.explainAf: Net die ~-penne (~3, ~5, ~6, ~9, ~10, ~11) kan die PWM-tydsein vir spoedbeheer lewer.

sections.title: Matching
sections.intro: Match column A to column B, and find the matching pairs.
sections.introAf: Pas kolom A by kolom B, en vind die pare wat bymekaar pas.

questions.q: Match each Excel data type in column A with its use in column B.
questions.qAf: Pas elke Excel-datatipe in kolom A by sy gebruik in kolom B.
pairs: Calculable values with a chosen number of decimal places
Money, with a symbol (R) and 2 decimal places
Lines up currency symbols and decimal points in a column
Shows a % symbol; a fraction of 100
pairsAf: Berekenbare waardes met 'n gekose getal desimale plekke
Geld, met 'n simbool (R) en 2 desimale plekke
Belyn geldsimbole en desimale kommas in 'n kolom
questions.explain: The extra description in column B belongs to the Text data type.
questions.explainAf: Die ekstra beskrywing in kolom B behoort aan die Text-datatipe.

questions.q: Find the matching pairs: link each piece of information to the Java data type that should store it.
questions.qAf: Vind die pare wat bymekaar pas: koppel elke stukkie inligting aan die Java-datatipe wat dit moet stoor.
pairs: Whether a user is logged in
questions.explain: Whole numbers use int, decimals double, true or false boolean, and text (in double quotes) String.
questions.explainAf: Heelgetalle gebruik int, desimale getalle double, true of false boolean, en teks (tussen dubbele aanhalingstekens) String.

questions.q: Match each motor term in column A with its meaning in column B.
questions.qAf: Pas elke motorterm in kolom A by sy betekenis in kolom B.
pairs: A part that moves or controls something, like a wheel
The turning force of a motor
A shared set of rules devices use to talk to each other
pairsAf: 'n Deel wat iets beweeg of beheer, soos 'n wiel
Die rigting van die elektriese vloei
'n Gedeelde stel reëls wat toestelle gebruik om met mekaar te praat
extra: Copies power levels by switching electricity on and off very quickly
extraAf: Boots kragvlakke na deur elektrisiteit baie vinnig aan en af te skakel
questions.explain: The extra description in column B is PWM (Pulse Width Modulation).
questions.explainAf: Die ekstra beskrywing in kolom B is PWM (pulswydtemodulasie).

sections.title: Steps in order
sections.intro: Put the steps in the correct order.
sections.introAf: Plaas die stappe in die korrekte volgorde.

questions.q: Put the steps for making a plate with a row of holes (Linear Pattern) in the correct order.
questions.qAf: Plaas die stappe om 'n plaat met 'n ry gate (Linear Pattern) te maak, in die korrekte volgorde.
steps: Create Body and sketch a rectangle on the XY plane
Constrain the rectangle fully and Pad it
Sketch one circle on the top face and constrain its centre
Pocket the circle (Through All): this is the seed
Select the Pocket and apply a Linear Pattern
stepsAf: Create Body en skets 'n reghoek op die XY-vlak
Beperk die reghoek volledig en gebruik Pad
Skets een sirkel op die boonste vlak en beperk sy middelpunt
Gebruik Pocket op die sirkel (Through All): dit is die saadkenmerk (seed)
Kies die Pocket en pas 'n Linear Pattern toe
questions.explain: Pattern workflow: Body → sketch → constrain → Pad → one circle → Pocket (seed) → Linear Pattern with Extent and Occurrences → Save As.
questions.explainAf: Patroonwerkvloei: Body → skets → beperk → Pad → een sirkel → Pocket (seed) → Linear Pattern met Extent en Occurrences → Save As.

questions.q: Put the steps for giving cell B1 a name (a named range) in the correct order.
questions.qAf: Plaas die stappe om sel B1 'n naam te gee ('n benoemde reeks), in die korrekte volgorde.
steps: Type a name such as Cost_per_shirt in the Name Box
Press Enter to save the name
Use the name in a formula: =B3*Cost_per_shirt
stepsAf: Tik 'n naam soos Cost_per_shirt in die Name Box
Druk Enter om die naam te stoor
questions.explain: Method B of absolute referencing: the Name Box is left of the formula bar. A named cell stays fixed when the formula is copied, and the formula is easier to read.
questions.explainAf: Metode B van absolute verwysing: die Name Box is links van die formulebalk. 'n Benoemde sel bly vas wanneer die formule gekopieer word, en die formule is makliker om te lees.

sections.title: Scenarios
sections.intro: Read each scenario, then answer the questions about it.
sections.introAf: Lees elke scenario en beantwoord dan die vrae daaroor.

questions.scenario: Ayesha styles a page for Robot Day. This is her CSS and part of her HTML:
questions.scenarioAf: Ayesha stileer 'n bladsy vir Robotdag. Dit is haar CSS en 'n deel van haar HTML:

questions.q: What colour is the text Starts at 08:00?
questions.qAf: Watter kleur is die teks Starts at 08:00?
questions.explain: The <h4> has id="top", and #top sets the colour to #00FF00, which is green.
questions.explainAf: Die <h4> het id="top", en #top stel die kleur op #00FF00, wat groen is.

questions.q: How many lines of text are red?
questions.qAf: Hoeveel reëls teks is rooi?
questions.explain: Both paragraphs use class="note", and a class can be used many times.
questions.explainAf: Albei paragrawe gebruik class="note", en 'n klas kan baie keer gebruik word.

questions.q: Where must the <link> to style.css be placed?
questions.qAf: Waar moet die <link> na style.css geplaas word?
questions.explain: External CSS is linked with <link> in the <head> of every page that uses it.
questions.explainAf: Eksterne CSS word met <link> in die <head> gekoppel van elke bladsy wat dit gebruik.

questions.q: Ayesha may also use id="top" on the second paragraph.
questions.qAf: Ayesha mag id="top" ook op die tweede paragraaf gebruik.
questions.explain: An ID is unique: use it once per page, for one specific element. Use a class for several elements.
questions.explainAf: 'n ID is uniek: gebruik dit een keer per bladsy, vir een spesifieke element. Gebruik 'n klas vir verskeie elemente.

questions.scenario: Mr Dlamini types the marks of his 30 learners in B2:B31. Two learners were absent, so their cells are empty.
questions.scenarioAf: Mnr. Dlamini tik die punte van sy 30 leerders in B2:B31. Twee leerders was afwesig, dus is hulle selle leeg.

questions.q: What does =COUNT(B2:B31) give?
questions.qAf: Wat gee =COUNT(B2:B31)?
questions.explain: COUNT counts cells with numbers only and ignores empty cells: 30 − 2 = 28.
questions.explainAf: COUNT tel net selle met getalle en ignoreer leë selle: 30 − 2 = 28.

questions.q: What does =COUNTBLANK(B2:B31) give?
questions.qAf: Wat gee =COUNTBLANK(B2:B31)?
questions.explain: COUNTBLANK counts only the empty cells: the 2 absent learners.
questions.explainAf: COUNTBLANK tel net die leë selle: die 2 afwesige leerders.

questions.q: He wants marks below 50 to turn red automatically. Which tool should he use?
questions.qAf: Hy wil hê punte onder 50 moet outomaties rooi word. Watter hulpmiddel moet hy gebruik?
questions.explain: Conditional formatting changes how a cell looks when its value meets a rule (Home tab, Styles, Conditional Formatting), so the data jumps out.
questions.explainAf: Voorwaardelike formatering verander hoe 'n sel lyk wanneer sy waarde aan 'n reël voldoen (Home-oortjie, Styles, Conditional Formatting), sodat die data uitstaan.

questions.q: He wants a chart that compares the marks of the different learners. Which chart is best?
questions.qAf: Hy wil 'n grafiek hê wat die punte van die verskillende leerders vergelyk. Watter grafiek is die beste?
questions.explain: A bar or column chart compares different categories, such as the test results of different learners.
questions.explainAf: 'n Staaf- of kolomgrafiek vergelyk verskillende kategorieë, soos die toetsuitslae van verskillende leerders.

questions.scenario: Kabelo builds a robot arm. A servo motor opens and closes the gripper, and two DC motors drive the wheels through one L293D motor driver.
questions.scenarioAf: Kabelo bou 'n robotarm. 'n Servomotor maak die gryper oop en toe, en twee GS-motors dryf die wiele aan deur een L293D-motordrywer.

questions.q: Which servo mode lets the gripper move to an angle and hold it there?
questions.qAf: Watter servomodus laat die gryper na 'n hoek beweeg en dit daar hou?
questions.explain: A positional servo moves to an angle (0 to 180°) and stays there using holding torque.
questions.explainAf: 'n Posisionele servo beweeg na 'n hoek (0 tot 180°) en bly daar met houwringkrag (holding torque).

questions.q: A continuous-rotation servo is given the value 90. What does it do?
questions.qAf: 'n Servo met aaneenlopende rotasie kry die waarde 90. Wat doen dit?
questions.explain: For continuous rotation, 90 = stop, 0 = full speed reverse and 180 = full speed forward.
questions.explainAf: Vir aaneenlopende rotasie is 90 = stop, 0 = volspoed agteruit en 180 = volspoed vorentoe.

questions.q: He wants the wheels to turn at 40% power. Which PWM value should he use?
questions.qAf: Hy wil hê die wiele moet teen 40% krag draai. Watter PWM-waarde moet hy gebruik?

questions.q: Why can one L293D drive both wheel motors?
questions.qAf: Hoekom kan een L293D albei wielmotors aandryf?
options: The chip is split into two halves that each control one motor independently
The motors share one Arduino pin
The Arduino supplies 400 mA per pin
The motors are connected in parallel to the 5 V pin
optionsAf: Die skyfie is in twee helftes verdeel wat elkeen een motor onafhanklik beheer
Die Arduino lewer 400 mA per pen
Die motors is in parallel aan die 5 V-pen gekoppel
questions.explain: The L293D is split into two halves, so one chip drives two motors independently. It also keeps the motor power separate from the Arduino's 5 V logic.
questions.explainAf: Die L293D is in twee helftes verdeel, dus dryf een skyfie twee motors onafhanklik aan. Dit hou ook die motorkrag apart van die Arduino se 5 V-logika.
